en: Dependent on a state that is not associated with the taints (anāsava), a state that is not associated with the taints arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is not associated with the taints, a state that is not non-associated with the taints (na-anāsava) arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is not associated with the taints, states that are both not associated with the taints and not non-associated with the taints arise by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither with taints nor without taints, a state that is neither with taints nor without taints arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is both with taints and without taints, a state that is neither with taints nor without taints arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
Under root condition there are five; under object condition there are two … pe … under non-disappearance condition there are five. (The full detail applies everywhere.)
